column1: # file<TAB>line<TAB>site - overrides sitemap.tsv where one function holds
# work belonging to different sites (forward.c does, all six of its
# billing points sit in one of three functions).
# forward.c line keys belong to blob ae54f175, which is 75a1604's - the
# commit that last touched the file, not 2b1150d as first written here.
# Regenerated from e65f181's map by matching each mapped line's source
# TEXT into the new file, never by shifting numbers: 32 of 36 landed on
# The four that did not, and how each was placed:
#   `s->qn[i] *= scale`  - matches twice in BOTH files (old 2063 and
#     2823, new 2361 and 3190). The old map listed only 2823, so one of
#     the two occurrences had been falling into the default bucket since
#     the map was written. Both are mapped now; that is a hole fixed,
#   the residual add     - matches twice in both (old 3545/3565, new
#     4092/4112). Placed order-preserving; both carry the same site, so
#     the assignment does not affect any roll-up.
#   `float k1 = decay_base[h] * gk`  - DROPPED. 665a19b replaced the
#     gate's folded float coordinate with sigmoid_q15_ti/lz_exp_t, so
#     that line no longer exists and the work it carried is attributed
#     by function name through sitemap.tsv instead.
# compare.sh refuses to run when src/forward.c is not this blob. That is
# the point: line keys go stale silently, and a stale map moves work
# between sites while still printing a table.
